checkpoint_chronology.manifest_state: The paper declares approximately five million cells, 35 billion cCRE tokens, 28 dataset collections and 31 tissues for pretraining. The current Human-scATAC-Corpus v1.0.0 is larger, with more than 5.4 million cells and 35 datasets. No immutable checkpoint-bound accession and sample manifest was recovered.

gse244832.allowed_use: Same-donor, different-aliquot ATAC representation diagnostics only after a separate development TaskSpec; never create cell-to-cell RNA-ATAC pairs.
gse244832.evidence: GSE244832 became public on 2024-11-13, before the historical checkpoint announcement and current Drive object. The exact checkpoint-bound Human-scATAC-Corpus accession manifest is unavailable.
gse244832.model_access: No use in fitting, prototype construction, calibration, or model selection for a GSE244832 external-development score.

gse289173.allowed_use: None for EpiAgent under the current sealed tasks because the evaluator exposes RNA-only nuclei and eQTL/ieQTL summaries, not ATAC cCRE tokens.
gse289173.evidence: GSE289173 became public on 2025-02-12. It postdates the historical checkpoint announcement but predates the current mutable Drive object's modification time; no digest or version history binds the current object to the historical weights.
gse289173.model_access: No sealed feature or outcome access; model is modality-ineligible independently of contamination status.

gse296875.allowed_use: Same-nucleus ATAC representation diagnostics within outer donor folds after its donor/well/reference authorities and a separate ATAC TaskSpec pass.
gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 first became public on 2025-10-01, after the current Drive object's 2025-08-09 modification time.
gse296875.model_access: Outer-training donors only may contribute any fine-tuning, heads, prototypes, normalization beyond the frozen corpus TF-IDF, or early stopping.

rules.checkpoint_identity: Chronology cannot substitute for a content hash. Any acquired object remains exposure-unknown for pre-modification datasets until its digest and version provenance are frozen.
rules.modality: ATAC-only models cannot enter the RNA-only sealed cell-state task or an RNA-conditioned profile task whose inference contract forbids observed ATAC.
rules.pairing: GSE296875 is same-nucleus. GSE244832 is same-sample different aliquot and permits donor-compatible comparison only.
